tests.name: Affected PHP runtime detection
tests.expected_result: Both CVEs should be reported if supported by the scanner and advisory database
tests.verification_criteria: Verify scanner output contains explicit CVE-2026-109618 and CVE-2026-109619 entries with Critical severity rating.

tests.name: Patched PHP runtime control test
tests.expected_result: Neither CVE should be reported as affecting that runtime
tests.verification_criteria: Zero findings for either CVE. If flagged, investigate version comparator rule in scanner for premature boundary inclusion.

tests.name: Repository-only SCA test
tests.expected_result: Depends on whether the PHP runtime is discoverable
tests.verification_criteria: If scanner inspects only Composer package dependencies, mark as 'Inconclusive / Out of Scope'. If scanner parses Dockerfile base images, verify whether it flags the base image tag.

tests.name: Container image scanning test
tests.expected_result: Depends on image inventory and CVE coverage
tests.verification_criteria: Scanner must inspect container OS packages (Alpine apk) or the compiled PHP binary to report CVE-2026-109618 and CVE-2026-109619 on the vulnerable image.

tests.name: Zero-findings diagnostic evaluation
tests.expected_result: Investigate coverage, inventory, and advisory freshness before concluding
tests.verification_criteria: A zero-finding scan on vulnerable 8.3.35 is NOT a test pass. Never mark a test as passed merely because the scan command completed successfully without errors.
